description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Nautilus''' sends out a [[File:Depth Charge 2.png|20px|link=]] ''Depth Charge'' that chases the target enemy [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champion]], accelerating over time and creating eruptions every 0.264 seconds in its wake that also briefly grant [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] of the area. Enemies hit by the eruptions are dealt magic damage, [[File:Airborne icon.png|20px|link=Airborne|An icon representing the keyword Airborne]] [[:Airborne|knocked up]] for 1 second, and [[File:Stun icon.png|20px|link=Stun|An icon representing the keyword Stun]] [[:Stun|stunned]] for a duration.
description.text: Active: Nautilus sends out a Depth Charge that chases the target enemy champion, accelerating over time and creating eruptions every 0.264 seconds in its wake that also briefly grant sight of the area. Enemies hit by the eruptions are dealt magic damage, knocked up for 1 second, and stunned for a duration.

description2.raw: Upon reaching the primary target, the ''Depth Charge'' erupts a final time at their location. The primary target takes increased damage, is [[File:Stun icon.png|20px|link=Stun|An icon representing the keyword Stun]] [[:Stun|stunned]] for the same duration, and [[File:Airborne icon.png|20px|link=Airborne|An icon representing the keyword Airborne]] [[:Airborne|knocked up]] for a modified duration.
description2.text: Upon reaching the primary target, the Depth Charge erupts a final time at their location. The primary target takes increased damage, is stunned for the same duration, and knocked up for a modified duration.

notes.raw: * ''Depth Charge'' starts in an offset from whichever direction '''Nautilus''' is facing at the end of the cast time. ** Since [[File:Nautilus Dredge Line.png|20xpx|border|link=Nautilus#Dredge Line|An icon for Nautilus's ability Dredge Line]] [[Nautilus#Dredge Line|Dredge Line's]] causes '''Nautilus''' to change his facing direction upon hitting a valid target, ''Depth Charge's'' starting point can be changed with a quick [[File:Nautilus Dredge Line.png|20xpx|border|link=Nautilus#Dredge Line|An icon for Nautilus's ability Dredge Line]] [[Nautilus#Dredge Line|Dredge Line]] + ''Depth Charge'' combo. * Enemies a certain distance away from the charge / eruption are instead [[File:Airborne icon.png|20px|link=Airborne|An icon representing stop chasing if the target dies or becomes untargetable. * [[File:Nautilus Dredge Line.png|20xpx|border|link=Nautilus#Dredge Line|An icon for Nautilus's ability Dredge Line]] [[Nautilus#Dredge Line|Dredge Line]] will not override ''Depth Charge's'' [[File:Airborne icon.png|20px|link=Airborne|An icon representing the keyword Airborne]] [[:Airborne|knock up]]. * [[File:Unstoppable icon.png|20px|link=Crowd control#Displacement_Immunity|An icon representing the keyword Displacement immune]] [[:Crowd control#Displacement_Immunity|Displacement immunity]] will not resist the application of the [[File:Stun icon.png|20px|link=Stun|An icon representing the keyword Stun]] [[:Stun|stun]]. * If the target becomes [[File:Untargetable icon.png|20px|link=Untargetable|An icon representing the keyword Untargetable]] [[:Untargetable|untargetable]], [[File:Death icon.svg|20px|link=Death|An icon representing the keyword Death]] [[:Death|dies]], or is too far away or no longer in [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] during the cast time, this ability will cancel but does not go on [[File:Cooldown icon.png|15px|link=Cooldown]] cooldown nor pay its cost (if applicable).
notes.text:
Depth Charge starts in an offset from whichever direction Nautilus is facing at the end of the cast time.
* Since Dredge Line's causes Nautilus to change his facing direction upon hitting a valid target, Depth Charge's starting point can be changed with a quick Dredge Line + Depth Charge combo.
Enemies a certain distance away from the charge / eruption are instead knocked back.
Depth Charge's final eruption will occur prematurely if the primary target moves more than 3000 units away from it.
Depth Charge will not stop chasing if the target dies or becomes untargetable.
Dredge Line will not override Depth Charge's knock up.
Displacement immunity will not resist the application of the stun.
If the target becomes untargetable, dies, or is too far away or no longer in sight during the cast time, this ability will cancel but does not go on  cooldown nor pay its cost (if applicable).
